summary: MetaMask snap prompts user for BIP-39 Secret Recovery Phrase and returns it to calling dApp
details: wallet-monitor-snap is published as a MetaMask Snap advertising 'real-time transaction monitoring and gas fee optimization', but its onRpcRequest handler exposes a 'showSecurityAlert' method that invokes snap_dialog with a prompt instructing the user to enter their 12/24-word Secret Recovery Phrase under a fake 'unusual login' pretext, then returns the typed phrase to the calling web page as { captured: result }. The manifest declares endowment:rpc with dapps:true, so any web page that connects to the snap can invoke this method. Benign 'ping' and 'estimateGas' handlers are included alongside, with an in-source comment stating they exist so the snap 'appears legitimate during store review'. Capture of a BIP-39 mnemonic yields full, permanent control of the user's wallet and all associated funds.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
